title: San's Archaeology Expansion
description: An expansion to the archaeology system. It also adds more things for the sniffer to sniff up, as well as pawn shops.
body:
# San's Archaeology Expansion!
### **General Info**
This is a relatively small expansion mod about archaeology.

It does not have the purpose of changing the game in any large way (at least as of now) and currently is only intended to expand on a few subjects (and it will never be as enormous as AC&A). It also adds **NEW** banner patterns!!

### **Structures**
The mod also adds a bunch of structures, and more are to come! Sand piles, crashed bee hives and more! All of these structures have something in then, whether it's suspicious blocks or chests or similar.

### **Vanilla Changes**
The mod changes a bunch of vanilla loot tables, currently mainly suspicious blocks.

### **Reasons To Download**
There are multiple reasons to download this mod, it expands vanilla systems and adds building blocks. It also adds a new way to get emeralds from trading with villagers. Specifically, it adds the pawnbroker villager. With whom you can trade some of your finds. Though most additions are only for decorative purposes.
